long_biography.plain_text:
Pacific Air Forces placed James A. Jacobson among the senior officers responsible for American air power across the Indo-Pacific. Promoted to three-star rank in 2021, he served as deputy commander while the headquarters deepened day-to-day integration with allied officers and prepared forces spread across a vast operating region.

Jacobson graduated from the United States Air Force Academy in 1990. Earlier commands included the 573rd Global Support Squadron at Travis Air Force Base and the 376th Air Expeditionary Wing in Kyrgyzstan. He also served in staff posts at Transportation Command, Air Mobility Command, the Joint Staff and Air Force headquarters, developing experience in how forces move and deploy.
